principle: Platform observables are measurements of behavior/events first. They are not one-to-one estimates of latent psychological states.

validity_classes.direct_behavior: Directly observes a canonical behavioral action; may seed that behavior node when direction indicates observed presence/increase.
validity_classes.external_event: Directly observes an external system/social event; may seed the matching context event.
validity_classes.qualified_behavioral_proxy: Behavior is observed but construct mapping is ambiguous; may only seed as proxy_hypothesis.
validity_classes.validated_construct_measure: May seed a latent node only when the observation explicitly documents validated instrument use and domain match.
validity_classes.ambiguous_platform_proxy: Never auto-seeds a latent node; only creates bounded candidate explanations.

proxies.warning: Observed sharing identifies transmission behavior, not motive, trust, identity signaling, or virality.
Recommendation action is observed; the psychological reason for recommending remains unresolved.

proxies.description: Observed likes/comments/replies or other social feedback events returned to a post/account.
proxies.warning: Feedback occurrence is an external event; its subjective reward value varies by person and context.
A profile visit is compatible with information seeking but can also reflect monitoring, controversy, navigation, or unrelated goals.

proxies.description: Construct-matched survey of perceived trustworthiness and/or expertise.
proxies.warning: Perceived credibility is domain-specific and is not factual accuracy.

proxies.description: Fraction of exposed viewers remaining past an early-view threshold.
proxies.warning: Hold can reflect salience, relevance, curiosity, autoplay, friction, format, or audience selection; it cannot identify a specific attention mechanism alone.

proxies.description: Fraction of starts reaching content completion.
proxies.warning: Completion is multiply determined by length, pacing, prior selection, utility, curiosity, and platform behavior.
Saving may reflect utility, deferred consumption, collection, reminders, or platform-specific behavior; it is not a direct subjective-value measure.
Returning is an outcome and does not prove habit, trust, parasocial relationship, or reinforcement.

proxies.description: Repeated active engagement with the same creator across exposures.
proxies.warning: Repeated engagement can reflect relationship, utility, controversy, monitoring, incentives, or habit; it does not diagnose any one construct.

proxies.description: Content-analysis score for self/group identity language.
proxies.warning: Identity language does not establish identification strength, identity centrality, or active self-categorization without construct-valid coding and context.
